notes.title: New Update! Shooting Range & Art Updates
notes.notes:
We've just released an update for Barrels Up featuring new art assets and a new Shooting Range gamemode accessible from the main menu with Local Highscores.

Change Log:
- New art assets
- Re-designed Endless Mode level layout
- Tweaked Endless Mode barrel spawning and shortened wave lengths
- Added Shooting Range gamemode with local highscores
